reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: completeRegistration is exported and called from register/[token]/page-client.tsx (non-zero non-test callers). Gate 2: BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json has no trust_assumptions; entry point is the public /register/[token] form, user-controlled input with no trusted-source designation. Gate 3: src/app/actions.ts is in scope and token reuse is a listed key security concern. An attacker can trigger this via the /register/[token] POST endpoint by submitting the same QR token concurrently with the legitimate user, causing both requests to pass the is_used==false check (L243) before either commits the is_used=true update (L267), allowing the attacker to win the card-to-Discord upsert race and lock the victim out of their own NFC card. Severity maintained at High; no client_diversity cap defined in scope file.
